summary: Updated nodejs packages fix security vulnerabilities
details:
http2: retain header memory in session accounting. (CVE-2026-56846)
http2: defer rst stream while in scope. (CVE-2026-56848)
permission: avoid granting radix split nodes. (CVE-2026-58043)
https: distinguish PFX object-array agent keys. (CVE-2026-56850)
https: bind identity checks to session reuse. (CVE-2026-58040)
dns: handle large resolveAny address replies. (CVE-2026-58042)
zlib: throw on out-of-bounds write buffers. (CVE-2026-58045)
permission: enforce fs write permission for trace events.
(CVE-2026-56847)
permission: check final report output path. (CVE-2026-58039)
http: reject requests exceeding max header count. (CVE-2026-58044)
